## Purpose

This report compares the Week 3 manually created `final_data` with an independently created agent dataset. A comparison is only meaningful once both complete datasets exist.

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
original_path <- 'data/processed/final_data.csv'
agent_path <- 'data/processed/final_data_agent.csv'
if (!file.exists(original_path) || !file.exists(agent_path)) {
  stop('Add both complete files: final_data.csv and final_data_agent.csv. Do not compare partial_data_without_covariates.csv as final.')
}
original <- read_csv(original_path, show_col_types=FALSE)
agent <- read_csv(agent_path, show_col_types=FALSE)
```

## Dimensions and variable names

```{r}
tibble(dataset=c('Original','Agent'), rows=c(nrow(original),nrow(agent)), columns=c(ncol(original),ncol(agent)))
tibble(only_in_original=setdiff(names(original),names(agent)) %>% paste(collapse=', '),
       only_in_agent=setdiff(names(agent),names(original)) %>% paste(collapse=', '))
```

## Variable types

```{r}
common <- intersect(names(original),names(agent))
tibble(variable=common, original=sapply(original[common], function(x) class(x)[1]),
       agent=sapply(agent[common], function(x) class(x)[1])) %>%
  filter(original != agent)
```

## Missingness

```{r}
missing_summary <- function(df,label) {
  tibble(variable=names(df), missing=vapply(df, function(x) sum(is.na(x)), integer(1)), dataset=label)
}
bind_rows(missing_summary(original,'Original'),missing_summary(agent,'Agent')) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=dataset,values_from=missing) %>%
  mutate(difference=Original-Agent) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(difference)))
```

## Duplicated keys

```{r}
stopifnot(all(c('iso','year') %in% names(original)), all(c('iso','year') %in% names(agent)))
bind_rows(original %>% count(iso,year) %>% filter(n>1) %>% mutate(dataset='Original'),
          agent %>% count(iso,year) %>% filter(n>1) %>% mutate(dataset='Agent'))
```

## Country-year and variable-value differences

```{r}
keys <- c('iso','year')
anti_join(original,agent,by=keys) %>% select(all_of(keys)) %>% head(25)
anti_join(agent,original,by=keys) %>% select(all_of(keys)) %>% head(25)
if (anyDuplicated(original[keys]) || anyDuplicated(agent[keys])) stop('Resolve duplicated country-year keys before comparison')
shared <- intersect(setdiff(names(original),keys),setdiff(names(agent),keys))
left <- original %>% select(all_of(c(keys,shared))) %>% arrange(iso,year)
right <- agent %>% select(all_of(c(keys,shared))) %>% arrange(iso,year)
joined <- inner_join(left,right,by=keys,suffix=c('_original','_agent'))
differences <- lapply(shared,function(v) {
  x <- joined[[paste0(v,'_original')]]
  y <- joined[[paste0(v,'_agent')]]
  unequal <- if(is.numeric(x) && is.numeric(y)) !(abs(x-y) <= 1e-8 | (is.na(x)&is.na(y))) else !(as.character(x)==as.character(y) | (is.na(x)&is.na(y)))
  unequal[is.na(unequal)] <- TRUE
  tibble(variable=v, different=sum(unequal))
}) %>% bind_rows() %>% arrange(desc(different))
differences
```
